en.title: Closed-Type Air-Aspirating Foam-Water Sprinkler
en.lead: A closed-type foam-water sprinkler with a woven metal mesh, air inlet openings and a glass-bulb operating element. Copper frame and connection body, with BSPT threads.
en.note: BSPT identifies the thread family, not a factory model. Exact sizes, temperature rating, response classification, K-factor and pressure data are available on request. Confirm the foam concentrate and nozzle compatibility for the project.
